selectionEntries.comment:
GS39 PRACTICE: Practice now uses the exact same Extra Unit Copy Cost branch as Quick: four normal-cost Troop copies and one normal-cost Other copy. The Practice branch below is derived from the current Quick branch; Standard and Long arithmetic are unchanged.

EXTRA UNIT COPY COSTS / CURRENT. Permanent required accounting entry. Troop and Other arithmetic remain logically separate but live directly on this single visible parent. Hormagaunts (10), normal Termagants (10), and Gargoyles (10) remain the three independent Troop copy families. Living Incubator broods remain distinct zero-point generated unit IDs and do not consume the normal Termagant allowance. Twelve native non-Rare Other families retain their established accounting; Neurolictor remains Rare and excluded. Practice / Quick / Standard / Long normal-copy allowances are 4 / 4 / 6 / 8 for Troops and 1 / 1 / 2 / 3 for Other. Each excess identical copy adds 20 Points.

selectionEntries.name: Updated: October 5th

rules.name: Patch Notes
rules.description:
Tyranids 3.3.7

• Warrior Wings added to the Warrior.
• Warrior w/ Wings can now attach to Gargoyles.
    ↳ List Builder: selected via the Attached Warrior options for Gargoyles.
• Warrior, Tyranid Prime, and Warrior Brood weapon choices updated to reflect replacing one Scything Talons.
    ↳ List Builder: the first weapon choice is melee-only; the second retains the full weapon list.
• Gargoyles gained Forward Deploy.
• Gargoyles' Screaming Swarm now requires the unit to have no leader model.
    ↳ List Builder: Screaming Swarm is hidden while an Attached Warrior is selected.
• Genestealers increased from 100 to 120 points.
• Genestealer Talons renamed Genestealer Claws.
• Tyrannofex gained Titan.

Changelog (October 5th)

• Attached Warrior: Hormagaunts and Termagants now hide Instinctive Swarm while a Warrior is attached.

Changelog (October 2nd)

• Presentation: removed embedded Rules text from unit upgrades; upgrade choices, costs, and any Unit Ability labels remain unchanged.

Changelog (September 29th)
• Presentation: removed redundant single-model unit-name headers, placing their existing equipment choices directly under Loadout Options.

Changelog (September 23rd)

• Presentation: standardized ◆ unit markers to the project-wide two-space format in roster exports.
• 420 Point Practice: now uses 0 Leader Points and Quick-equivalent Extra Unit Copy Cost allowances; LP-costing units are hidden unless already selected.

Changelog (September 21st)

• Standardized Configuration ordering across the listbuilder.
• Presentation: standardized ◆ unit presentation; cleaned Additional Model labels for Ripper Swarms, Hive Guard, and Tyrant Guard.

Changelog (September 19th)

• Presentation: adopted the current emoji-enabled listbuilder presentation, including LP ⭐, 🏷️ Unit Abilities, 🧰 Loadout Options, and shared category icons.
• Unit Abilities: added all top-level Unit Ability names across the army.
• Added 420 Point Practice support across Leader Points, Living Incubator, and Extra Unit Copy Costs; Living Incubator grants no free broods in Practice.
• Neurothrope - Leech Essence and Trygon Prime - Synapse now appear only with their matching upgrades.

Changelog (September 17th)

• Added source model-count suffixes across Tyranid multi-model units.
• Hive Tyrant, Tervigon, and Neurotyrant now spend all Leader Points granted by Game Size; Warrior remains 0 LP.
• Standardized checkbox controls for Ripper Swarm extra models, Attached Warrior, Hive/Tyrant Guard extra models, and Zoanthrope/Trygon upgrades.
• Hive Guard loadouts now use atomic cannon & Powerful Limbs packages; added the Frenzied Feeders Ripper Swarm model counter.

selectionEntries.comment:
REV61 release audit: consolidated only player-facing 3.3.6 catalogue changes into simple Patch Notes, retained the Discord link and all prior historical changelogs, added one presentation-only September 29th changelog entry. Removed 12 redundant single-model wrapper groups by transplanting the original radio groups/choices and constraints directly under Loadout Options. No executable unit changes; previous WIP implementation steps remain solely in catalogue-level internal revision documentation.
REV60 WIP: added Rending Claws to the shared Warrior and each Warrior Brood model, in both weapon slots, with matching selected-safe Winged hiding in Brood slot 1. The eight existing slot defaults remain Scything Talons. Nested abilities, created-only Spore Mines and further Biovore work are explicitly out of scope; released Changelog unchanged.
REV59 WIP: changed each base Ravener to individual mandatory Ravener Claws & Talons and individual native-empty paid gun slot, following the already implemented fourth-model pattern. Changed existing Tyrannofex paired gun label to 2x Fleshborer Hive. Consolidated Biovore’s loadout to one fixed Biovore Spore Mine launcher. No other unit mechanics, released Changelog, or deferred nested ability work changed.
REV58 WIP: implemented all ten remaining staged new-unit loadouts and paid model/equipment options. Individual created-only Spore Mines are deliberately not recruitable; separate nested abilities remain outside the current pass. Historical released Changelog unchanged.
REV57 WIP: Completed Tyranid Prime, including two default-Talons slots, first-slot Winged rename/safe hiding, and per-attached-brood exact Winged matching validation. No released Changelog entry.
REV56 WIP: Completed 3.3.6 Carnifex rework, including two six-weapon slots, three optional native-empty weapon radios, four +10 ability checkboxes and linked profiles; no released Changelog entry.
REV55 WIP: gated all three Winged Warrior correction errors behind an explicit selected-upgrade condition. Corrective messages and all weapon options remain unchanged. Unreleased WIP; historical Changelog unchanged.
REV54 WIP: updated Warrior Brood Winged per-model corrective error wording to include the problem, the unit-wide restriction, and clear remedies; executable conditions unchanged. Unreleased work, so historical Changelog is unchanged.
REV53 WIP: condensed Winged Warriors corrective messages and added selected-safe hiding of non-Wings alternatives in each Warrior’s first loadout slot; second slots untouched. Live New Recruit visibility/switching still needs confirmation. This remains unreleased WIP, not a new historical Changelog event.
REV52 WIP: implemented Warrior Brood unit-wide Winged upgrade and first-slot conditional naming/repair. All remaining 3.3.6 options are intentionally deferred; this is not a released changelog event.
3.3.6 PHASE 1: this is an intermediate unpublished revision, not a completed release. Changelog entries for 3.3.6 will be composed after completing unit options/loadouts. Existing historical Changelog remains unchanged.
REV42 CURRENT TEMPLATE. The September 19th Changelog section records only the actual player-facing delta from the live REV40 catalogue to the finished current-template state. The September 17th historical section is preserved unchanged. September 21st presentation pass replaces unit and linked-unit chevrons with ◆  and removes the prefix marker from Additional Model checkboxes. REV43 adopts GS38 and the standardized Configuration ordering. REV44 adopts GS39 Practice: 0 LP, selected-safe hiding for LP-costing units, and Quick-equivalent copy thresholds. Changelog entries are intentionally concise; detailed implementation history remains in the catalogue-level revision comments.

selectionEntries.name: ◆  Tyranid Prime
selectionEntries.comment:
3.3.7 / Tyranid Prime loadout: the first required weapon radio is melee-only (Scything Talons, Rending Claws, 2x Bone Sword, Bone Sword & Lash Whip, Rending Claw & Lash Whip); the second required weapon radio retains the full ten-option Prime weapon list. Both default to Scything Talons. The +10 Winged checkbox conditionally renames ONLY first-slot Scything Talons to Prime Wings and hides other unselected first-slot weapons (already selected alternatives remain visible for correction). The second slot is unrestricted. The +10 Winged selection retains its existing loadout/attachment mechanics; the linked 🪽 Winged Unit Ability label is retained without embedded rules text. Zero LP unchanged. Two independent normal/Winged associations follow Chaos Lord/Master of Possession. Incoming association IDs are checked on the PARTICULAR Warrior Brood, using the proven Space Marines Assault Intercessors inbound attachment technique, so other broods in the same roster cannot accidentally satisfy the match. New Recruit runtime test required for 4 combinations and toggling after association.
A zero-LP external Leader, requires Warrior Brood with matching Winged state. The Winged purchase and matching restriction were implemented in REV57.

selectionEntries.comment:
REV54: The three player-facing errors now consistently state what is wrong, why it is illegal, and how the player fixes it; each message names its specific Warrior. All conditions, selection behavior, costs, naming, visibility, and linked abilities are unchanged.
One +10-point unit-wide checkbox. While selected, each first-slot Scything Talons choice is conditionally named Warrior Wings, and the other unselected options in those first-slot lists are hidden. Selected incompatible first-slot options remain visible for correction, each prompting a short model-specific error. Second-slot choices, groups/defaults, and ordinary no-Winged name consolidation are unchanged. This preserves every pre-existing ID and uses the same selected-safe hidden-modifier pattern as conditional faction wargear elsewhere in the listbuilder.

REV60 / GS41: Rending Claws are added to both mandatory weapon slots for all three Warriors. First-slot Rending Claws follow the existing Winged selected-safe conditional hiding; second slots retain full regular choices. Existing IDs, defaults, Winged upgrade cost, conditional renaming of first-slot Scything Talons and corrective errors are unchanged.
REV57 attachment validation: two host-side instance-specific error rules compare this brood’s Winged selection to the incoming Tyranid Prime normal vs Winged association slot IDs, preserving the existing single-Prime restriction. Pattern is taken from Space Marines Assault Intercessors Jump Pack attachment matching, not a roster-wide Winged count.
REV55 FIX: Each of the three Winged corrective errors now requires the single Winged upgrade to be selected in its parent Loadout Options group before testing for missing first-slot Wings. This prevents error indicators on ordinary wingless broods.
REV54: Expanded Winged Warriors corrective errors to explain the invalid first-slot loadout, the unit-wide Wings requirement, and both available remedies. No equipment/visibility mechanics changed.
REV53 WINGED UX: selecting Winged (+10) renames each Warrior’s first-slot Scything Talons option Warrior Wings and hides all other UNSELECTED alternatives in the first-slot groups. A previously selected incompatible option stays visible so the user can switch it to Wings, prompted by a concise per-model error. The second-slot groups are unchanged, all equipment/default IDs preserved. Unticking Winged restores all first-slot alternatives. Live New Recruit behavior still needs testing for this selected-safe local visibility pattern.
REV52 WINGED LOADOUT: one optional +10-point Winged Warriors upgrade in 🧰 Loadout Options. When selected, conditionally rename only the EXISTING first-slot Scything Talons choice of each Warrior to Warrior Wings; keep the second-slot choices, minimums, defaults and all existing IDs untouched. The selected Winged upgrade owns one model-specific corrective error for each first slot lacking its Scything Talons choice. Do NOT create actual extra Wings selections or hide mandatory selections. Warrior Brood Rending Claws, the Tyranid Prime Winged upgrade, and matching attachment validation are now implemented.
CURRENT EQUIPMENT NOMENCLATURE: Bone Sword, not Warrior Bone Sword. Existing IDs and the original equipment choices are retained. Rending Claws and the Winged conversion are now implemented.
3.3.7 LOADOUT UI: each Warrior uses two final-state arm-pair lists. The first list is melee-only (Scything Talons, Rending Claws, Paired Bone Swords, Bone Sword & Lash Whip); the second list retains the full melee-or-ranged weapon list. Existing Winged Warriors logic continues to convert the first-slot Scything Talons choice into Warrior Wings.
REV22 EXPORT WORDING: the six Warrior Brood arm-pair options formerly named '2x Warrior Bone Sword' are now named 'Paired Warrior Bone Swords'. All six existing selection IDs are preserved. This avoids New Recruit producing quantity text such as '6x 2x Warrior Bone Sword' when multiple identical arm pairs are selected.

modifiers.value: Warrior Brood has more than one Tyranid Prime attached. It may have only one. Remove or move an attached Prime.

This Warrior Brood has Winged but is attached to an Tyranid Prime without Winged. Their Winged status must match. Give that Prime Winged and reattach it under Attaches To (Winged), remove Winged from this brood, or move the Prime to an Warrior Brood without Winged.

This Warrior Brood is not Winged but is attached to a Tyranid Prime with Winged. Their Winged status must match. Purchase Winged and equip each model with Warrior Wings in its first slot, remove Winged from the Prime and reattach normally, or move the Prime to a Winged brood.

catalogue.comment:
REV63 / GS41 — TYRANIDS 3.3.7
Implemented the listbuilder-facing 3.3.7 changes: split Warrior, Tyranid Prime, and Warrior Brood weapon choices; added the Gargoyle-hosted Warrior w/ Wings nested state; preserved the existing Winged Prime/Brood attachment matching; added Forward Deploy to Gargoyles, Unstoppable to Winged Tyranid Prime, and Titan to Tyrannofex; increased Genestealers to 120 Points and renamed their fixed weapon to Genestealer Claws. Attached Warrior hosts now suppress Instinctive Swarm / Screaming Swarm as appropriate. Source-only battlefield rule-text changes remain outside the companion-listbuilder payload under the established top-level-ability-name scope.

REV62 / GS41 — UNIT UPGRADE RULE-TEXT CLEANUP
Removed embedded local Rules text from 2 unit upgrade selections. Upgrade selection IDs, costs, constraints, modifiers, profile links, Unit Ability labels, loadout logic, and all executable listbuilding mechanics are unchanged. Only the 2 local descriptive rule IDs attached to those upgrades were retired. Added one consolidated October 2nd presentation entry to the player-facing Changelog.

REV61 / GS41 — TYRANIDS 3.3.6 RELEASE AUDIT: Completed source-to-catalogue verification, one release-note pass and single-model presentation cleanup. Prior unpublished REV51–REV60 steps have been collapsed into the 3.3.6 Patch Notes instead of separate Changelog entries. No nested ability trees or recruitable created-only Spore Mines per scope; only top-level names of battlefield abilities are displayed. Preserved every existing semantic selection/constraint/default/association ID, while retiring 12 unreferenced redundant group IDs. New Recruit final visual smoke test remains.
REV60 / GS41 — TYRANIDS 3.3.6, UNRELEASED WIP: Added Rending Claws to both mandatory arm slots of the shared Warrior and to each arm slot of all three Warrior Brood models. For a Winged Brood, the new first-slot alternative uses the same selected-safe hiding pattern as the other first-slot alternatives, without altering the default Talons-to-Wings rename. All existing IDs, defaults, costs, matching attachments, and other units are retained. Per user instruction, no nested abilities, created-only Spore Mine representation, or Biovore rework is scheduled in this pass. New Recruit runtime check pending.
REV59 / GS41 — TYRANIDS 3.3.6, UNRELEASED WIP: Ravener individual base-model claws now appear under each Ravener header as a fixed mandatory radio before each model’s native-empty +10 ranged radio, identical to the optional fourth-model pattern; reused original aggregate claws group and entry IDs for model 1, added matching fixed choices for models 2/3, and normalized all four claws names to Ravener Claws & Talons. Tyrannofex’s paired hive package relabeled 2x Fleshborer Hive with its original ID. Biovore’s four-way spore selection collapsed to fixed Biovore Spore Mine launcher (old default option ID reused; three obsolete WIP option IDs retired). Existing abilities and all other units unchanged; created-only Spore Mines and nested abilities remain deferred. New Recruit runtime tests pending.
REV58 / GS41 — TYRANIDS 3.3.6, UNRELEASED WIP: Completed all remaining ten previously staged new playable unit loadouts: Winged Tyranid Prime, Raveners, Von Ryan’s Leapers, Stone-Crusher Carnifex, Screamer-Killer, Tyrannofex, Pyrovore, Maleceptor, Toxicrene and Biovore. Standard proven anonymous mandatory radios used for fixed or choice equipment, true native-empty optional radios for per-Ravener ranged weapons and Tyrannofex’s paid Stinger Salvoes, and proven max-one paid model wrapper for the optional fourth Ravener and Leaper. Preserved all existing IDs and all previously implemented Winged Warrior/Tyranid Prime attachment logic and Carnifex. Deliberately NOT added: separate nested ability profiles, created-only Spore Mine roster units, or the still-deferred old Warrior/Warrior Brood Rending Claws. Live New Recruit rendering still needs smoke-testing.
REV57 / GS41 — TYRANIDS 3.3.6, UNRELEASED WIP: Tyranid Prime. Added both mandatory independent Prime weapon radios (all 10 source choices) under Loadout Options without duplicate single-model heading; single +10 Winged checkbox uses existing Warrior Brood proven first-slot rename, selected-safe hiding, explicit corrective error, and existing Winged profile. Added normal and Winged attachment slots following CSM Chaos Lord/Master of Possession. Preserved original root and normal association IDs. Added per-instance two-way mismatch checks on Warrior Brood by incoming association slot ID based on proven Space Marines Jump Pack Assault Intercessors pattern; no roster-wide aggregation and no dynamic category modifiers. All unrelated units and pending loadouts remain unchanged. New Recruit runtime verification still required.
REV56 / GS41 — TYRANIDS 3.3.6, UNRELEASED WIP: Carnifex loadout pass. Removed duplicate Carnifex model heading. Two mandatory, identically populated six-weapon radio groups allow any two main weapons (including matching duplicates); preserved both old group IDs, both Scything Talons option IDs and all original secondary weapon IDs. Relabeled old extra Talons as normal Talons. Added Carnifex Devourers and missing first-slot choices. In the same Loadout Options section, added three independent optional native-empty radios: Tail Mace +10, Stinger Salvos +10, or one of Acid Maw/Tusks/Bio-Plasma Discharge +10. Unit Upgrade adds four separate max-one +10 checkboxes, with linked exact source ability profiles: Adrenal Glands, Thornback, Regeneration, Enhanced Senses. Weapon options here are catalogue name-only equipment entries consistent with their prior Carnifex implementation, not full weapon profiles. No other new unit equipment or deferred Tyranids loadouts changed; New Recruit runtime display remains to be tested.

Fixed all three per-model error modifiers by adding an explicit selected-Winged-Warriors check against their parent Loadout Options group. The established wording, first-slot weapon rename/selected-safe hiding, all existing IDs, and pending unit loadouts remain unchanged. Live runtime recheck required.

When the single +10-point upgrade is selected, hide each first-slot non-Scything Talons choice only if it is NOT already selected; keep already-selected incompatible choices visible for corrective replacement, with a short per-model error. First-slot Scything Talons is renamed Warrior Wings through existing conditional modifier; all second-slot choices and selection IDs remain unchanged. No other deferred 3.3.6 loadout work undertaken. REV52 / GS41 — TYRANIDS 3.3.6, UNRELEASED WIP: Warrior Brood Winged purchase implementation. One +10-point optional Winged Warriors choice owns the Winged unit-ability profile (Fly, +1D6 Move Rolls). WIP remains unreleased: Rending Claws, Tyranid Prime Winged matching validation and the other queued loadouts remain deferred.

Retargeted from GS40 to the current metadata-only GS41, changed catalogue name/version and refreshed the WIP marker. Updated current existing IDs only: Frenzied Feeders Ripper Swarms source wording, Warrior and Warrior Brood Bone Sword option names, Venomthrope Gas Bladders/Toxic Spores names, Carnifex 130 points and plural Death Spitters label, Hive Guard Unstoppable, Exocrine 170 points / no Unstoppable / Slaved Will.

DEFERRED ON USER MARK: Warrior and Warrior Brood Rending Claws; Warrior Brood Winged purchase; Tyranid Prime Winged purchase and Winged-status matching attachment validation; Carnifex two-weapon refactor and all new paid ability/weapon options; all equipment, mandatory fixed weapons, optional model additions and purchases of the eleven new units; any created Spore Mine representation. Original full REV50 and earlier revision history follows:

This component now targets Game System revision 39. CURRENT SYSTEM-WIDE CONFIGURATION ORDER / GS41
This catalogue targets Game System revision 41. Configuration presentation follows the shared lane doctrine: provenance warning 5 when applicable; Game Size 10; army identity 20; optional army structure 30; Leader Points 40; faction trackers 50; Extra Unit Copy Costs 80; Updated 90; About 100. Only locally-owned applicable lanes are stored in this file; Game Size, Leader Points, and About are supplied by the Game System. No unit IDs, costs, constraints, modifiers, attachment topology, loadout legality, or copy-cost arithmetic were changed by this pass.

CURRENT STATE — TYRANIDS 3.3.7 / GS41
Tyranids 3.3.7 targets Game System revision 41 and uses the current Leader Points, Practice, Extra Unit Copy Costs, Unit Abilities, and presentation infrastructure. Native roster units, shared Neuroloids, the unwinged and winged nested Warrior states, and the three Living Incubator Termagant brood structures retain stable IDs and current listbuilder semantics except where explicitly changed by the 3.3.7 implementation.

Hive Tyrant, Tervigon, and Neurotyrant each cost all Leader Points granted by Game Size at Quick / Standard / Long: 2 / 3 / 4 LP respectively. In 420 Point Practice, the Game Size grants 0 LP, so these LP-costing apex Leaders are unavailable unless already selected under the catalogue's selected-safe Practice hiding. They still share the independent pooled max-one HIVE TYRANT / TERVIGON / NEUROTYRANT restriction. Hive Tyrant alone carries the  command marker. Warrior remains a Countless 0-LP Leader with no LP cost object.

Living Incubator generates 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 zero-point nested Termagant broods at Practice / Quick / Standard / Long. These generated broods use distinct stable unit IDs, preserve normal Termagant loadout grammar at zero cost, may include the shared Warrior, and remain deliberately absent from normal Termagant Extra Unit Copy Cost accounting. Neurotyrant retains mandatory nested Neuroloids. Frenzied Feeders remains informational only and creates no Ripper unit.

Extra Unit Copy Costs uses one visible accounting entry. Hormagaunts (10), normal Termagants (10), and Gargoyles (10) remain the three Troop copy families; twelve non-Rare Other families retain their established accounting; Neurolictor remains Rare and excluded. Practice / Quick / Standard / Long normal-copy allowances are 4 / 4 / 6 / 8 for Troops and 1 / 1 / 2 / 3 for Other.

AUTHORING / PRESENTATION NOTES
Unit rows use ◆ ; 🧰 marks Loadout Options; immediate model-role headers use the Tyranids 🧬 marker; attachment relationship labels use 🔗; and Infantry, Vehicle, Monster, and Rare category labels use current Game System presentation. Ripper Swarms retain two independent +20 Point Additional Ripper Swarm Model checkboxes with no sequence or model-number meaning. Hive Guard and Tyrant Guard retain their direct max-one Additional Model checkboxes. Top-level Unit Ability names are represented as shared Profiles for all actual Tyranid unit structures, including the generated Living Incubator broods; nested sub-abilities are intentionally omitted.

OPTIONAL UNIT ABILITY PRESENTATION: top-level abilities granted by selectable upgrades are linked to the upgrade rather than the unit root, so New Recruit displays them only when that option is selected. Neurothrope - Leech Essence is linked to the Zoanthrope upgrade, and Synapse is linked to Trygon Prime - Synapse.

HISTORICAL SOURCE COMMENT FROM REV40
CURRENT STATE — TYRANIDS 3.3.4 / GS26
Tyranids 3.3.4 uses the mature final-state companion-listbuilder grammar. Native Troops Hormagaunts (10), Termagants (10), and Gargoyles (10) use the 4 / 6 / 8 Additional Copy Cost allowance; 12 non-Rare Other families use the 1 / 2 / 3 allowance. Neurolictor is Rare and excluded from soft-copy accounting.

CURRENT FACTION ARCHITECTURE
- Hive Tyrant, Tervigon, and Neurotyrant each cost all Leader Points granted by Game Size (2 / 3 / 4 LP at 800 / 1200 / 1600) and independently share one pooled army-list maximum. The pooled max-one restriction remains a separate legality axis from LP.
- Living Incubator is implemented as 1 / 2 / 3 zero-point nested Termagant brood units at 800 / 1200 / 1600 Points. These generated broods use distinct unit IDs, preserve the normal Termagant loadout grammar at zero cost, may include one nested shared Warrior, and deliberately do not consume normal Termagant Additional Copy Cost allowance.
- Warrior is a shared full Countless Leader unit exposed through checkbox-style Attached Warrior entryLinks on eligible Hormagaunt and Termagant hosts, including Living Incubator broods. It costs 0 leader points and therefore has no LP cost object.
- Neurotyrant includes mandatory nested Neuroloids.
- Frenzied Feeders is an informational roster counter driven by a hidden semantic category. It reports Ripper Swarm Size but creates no battlefield Ripper Swarm unit.
- Ripper Swarms use a four-model 80 Point root plus two independent +20 Point checkbox slots, both named Additional Ripper Swarm Model. The slots are interchangeable and have no sequencing or model-number meaning. The fixed core exports through the shared 4x Ripping Jaws package.
- Hive Guard 3 and Tyrant Guard 3 use direct checkbox-style Additional Model selections. Zoanthrope and Trygon optional upgrades use direct Unit Upgrade checkboxes.

AUTHORING / RUNTIME NOTES
- Rules descriptions sourced from the authoritative rules PDF are verbatim source text and are not editorialized by catalogue maintenance.
- Living Incubator broods are generated units, not normal Termagant copies. Keep their IDs out of the normal Troop copy-cost ledger.
- Attached Warrior is a nested full-unit relationship. Keep the relationship section, but max-1 belongs on the Warrior entryLink so New Recruit renders a checkbox.
- The Ripper Swarm base package intentionally separates concise editor labels from the canonical 4x Ripping Jaws export target.
